Percent of picked-up mob cash value charged from a nation member's primary bank account into the nation treasury (0 = none). Charged together with centralBankTaxPercent as one withdrawal.
Additional percent of picked-up mob cash value charged from the member and deposited into the UBS central bank's reserve (0 = none). Money sink — leaves player circulation.

Passive treasury income in cents per claimed chunk per recompute interval. NOTE: this accrues per recompute tick (server running time) while upkeep bills on wall-clock hours, so the real break-even is a server-uptime figure, not a flat number.
Territory income is multiplied by (1 + this * nationLevel).
Treasury cost in cents to buy level 2. Cost for level L = levelBaseCostCents * levelCostGrowth^(L-2).
Geometric growth of the level-up cost per level.
Minimum role allowed to spend treasury (levelup/perks/withdraw): 0 = SOVEREIGN only, 1 = SOVEREIGN+OFFICER.

Max ledger entries kept per nation.
Block treasury withdrawals while the nation has a war in WARMUP or ACTIVE phase, so a war chest cannot be emptied mid-campaign. Deposits are always allowed.
Charge every nation a recurring upkeep bill. Requires 'enabled' and Ultimate Banking System.

Hours between upkeep bills. All nations bill on the same global boundary. Changing this re-derives the whole schedule from the stored anchor, not just future boundaries: nations re-anchor to the new index on their next pass, so raising it can skip a bill and lowering it can trigger one immediately.
Upkeep cost in cents per claimed chunk per billing period. Sized against incomePerChunkCents: at both defaults a nation breaks even at roughly 3 hours of server uptime per day.
Upkeep cost in cents per nation level per billing period.

Cap the per-level upkeep term at this multiple of the per-chunk term. Income scales with claimed chunks alone, so without a cap a high-level, chunk-poor nation is structurally insolvent and its debt only deepens. At 1.0 the level bill can never exceed the territory bill. 0 disables the cap.
Max billing periods charged at once after server downtime. 1 means a week offline still costs one day.
Percent of the normal upkeep charged for a period in which no member was online (0-100).
Stop billing upkeep once the treasury is this many periods' worth of bills in debt. Keeps a returning nation able to dig out, and bounds what disbanding forgives. 0 means bill forever.

Pay the nation treasury interest on a positive balance. Requires 'enabled' and Ultimate Banking System — the payout is injected into UBS's own savings-interest tick, so nation treasuries and member savings accrue together.

Interest rate on the nation treasury, as a percent per 365 payouts. One payout happens per UBS savings-interest tick (its SavingsInterestIntervalTicks, default 24000 = one Minecraft day), so at defaults this is 1.8% per 365 Minecraft days, NOT per real year — lowering SavingsInterestIntervalTicks multiplies the real yield. Paid only to nations with a member active within the current or previous upkeepPeriodHours window (same activity signal as upkeep, not an instant online check); a treasury at or below zero earns nothing and debt never compounds. Sub-cent yield is dropped, so a balance below about 10139 cents earns nothing.

Unique skills added to the reincarnation pool.

options.section_comment: Integrations with other mods.

options.comment:
Enable Iron's Spellbooks integration.
When on: Tensura race tier/alignment grants IS spell-power and mana bonuses,
Tensura's magic cost multiplier scales IS spell mana costs,
and Whisper Djinn players are granted the Magic Scribe skill.
When off: these behaviors are disabled at runtime (no restart required).
Has no effect if Iron's Spellbooks is not installed.

options.section_comment: Race-specific tweaks applied on top of the base Tensura race system.

options.comment:
When true, players whose race is Wishbound Djinn or any later djinn tier
(Primordial / Ascended / Sovereign / Infinite / Omniversal) stop losing hunger
and saturation — the food bar is kept topped up each tick, mirroring how
slimes don't need to eat. Disable to restore vanilla hunger behaviour.

options.section_comment: Hyperbolic Chamber dimension tunables.

options.comment:
Multiplier applied to EP gained from kills inside the Hyperbolic Chamber.
3.0 = triple the EP. Set to 1.0 to disable the bonus.
Stacks multiplicatively with Tensura's own gear/alignment EP-gain modifiers —
applied AFTER Tensura's listener computes the base, so 'EP_GAIN' attribute
buffs and gamerule caps still apply normally.

options.section_comment: Ultimate Awakening ritual tunables.

options.comment:
Real-time minutes a player must wait between successful awakening
rituals. Per-player cooldown — building more altars doesn't bypass it.
0 disables the cooldown entirely.

options.section_comment:
Per-skill tuning. Each section has an 'enabled' flag plus that skill's
balance knobs. Disabling a skill makes it no-op (auto-unlock is blocked
and activation hooks short-circuit); it stays in the registry so any NBT
on existing saves remains valid.

options.section_comment:
Per-race tuning. Every addon race gets a section with an 'enabled' flag plus
its attribute bonuses, starting-EP range, and evolution EP gate.

Disabling a BASE race (Angel, Frog, Monkey, Whisper Djinn, Fledgling Bloodfiend,
Gazer) removes it from the reincarnation pool. Disabling an evolved race keeps
the flag in place for future use — currently it has no gameplay effect.

The MOVEMENT_SPEED bonus is a multiplier (0.20 = +20%), applied on top of the
entity's base speed. All other bonuses are flat adds.
Angel line — Holy alignment, flight-focused.
Angel — attribute bonuses and EP thresholds.

options.section_comment:
IMPORTANT, This is not where you change relic stats.
To do that you need to enable enabledExtendedConfigs in relic.yaml and it will auto generate relic config files in config/morerelics/relics upon running the game once. You can change the values from there.
Although I DO NOT RECOMMEND doing that because it is a very buggy system. If you enable it, when I update the mod it will still try to fetch values from those files.
This means when I change stat values those won't affect your game and if I change/add an ability to a relic it will crash with "data is null".
To fix this you would need to delete the updated relics config file in config/morerelics/relics so it can regenerate correctly on your next launch.
